issues.message: Loading, empty, error, partial, selected, and stale states are visible, but most are static examples instead of being wired into table/filter/detail behavior.
evidence: State shelf includes labels, but filtering to zero results does not render a dedicated empty table state.
Error and loading states are not represented in the main workflow.

issues.message: Mock data requirements mention timestamps, but the runs table does not expose started/updated timestamps or freshness per run.
evidence: Table columns are Run, Agent, Status, Score, Model, Duration, Tokens.
Only the global header shows stale: 11 min old.

issues.message: Charts create a trend impression but lack axis labels, current values, or legends, reducing 5-10 second scan value.
evidence: Quality chart and latency chart use SVG marks without labeled time buckets or values.

issues.message: Dark mode toggle changes theme but does not update button label or aria state.
evidence: Button always reads Dark mode after switching to light mode.

issues.message: Detail panel shows key fields but not enough trace evidence, timestamps, or next action to audit a failure quickly.
evidence: Trace summary is a static string: plan -> act -> tool -> eval -> feedback.
